All 182 entries of the Python client API, grouped by object. Each row
gives the matching CLI command and MCP tool where one exists, so you
can move between surfaces.

Rows marked **(nightly)** are not in the latest release (26.8.21);
**(changed in nightly)** means the documented signature differs from that release.
See [What's in Nightly](../../nightly.md). The same data for every
surface is in the [API matrix](../../reference/api-matrix.md) and in
[`/api.json`](/api.json).

## Browser

| Python | What it does | CLI | MCP |
|---|---|---|---|
| `browser.start(opts?)` | Launch browser and connect | `vibium start` | `browser_start` |
| `browser.page()` | Get the default page |  |  |
| `browser.new_page()` | Create a new page | `vibium page new` | `browser_new_page` |
| `browser.new_context()` | Create a new browser context |  |  |
| `browser.pages()` | List all pages | `vibium pages` | `browser_list_pages` |
| `browser.stop()` | Stop the browser | `vibium stop` | `browser_stop` |
| `browser.on_page(cb)` | Listen for new page events |  |  |
| `browser.on_popup(cb)` | Listen for popup events |  |  |
| `browser.remove_all_listeners(ev?)` | Remove all event listeners |  |  |
